name: Bellybulge
description: A peaceful scavenger of the sheltered shallows, active from the very start of the game. One of the standard Wind-Up Tin catches around the Trading Post.

name: Cryptmaw
description: A predator haunting the channels around the Trading Post. Drawn out with a moving lure cast into a splash zone.

name: Glowbug
description: A Sea Blight mutant found only in blighted backwater. Uses the standard predator catch loop but is much rarer than its standard counterparts.

name: Gravedigger
description: A Blight-twisted peaceful fish of the drowned ruins. Takes standard peaceful bait despite its corrupted appearance.

name: Hornhead
description: A predator of the open swamp channels. Follows a steadily retrieved lure before striking.

name: Necrosoft
description: A mutant peaceful fish lying in the deep silt beds. One of the wider-ranging mutant habitats in the demo data.

name: Plasmling
description: A predatory fish of the warm shallows. Responds to a moving lure retrieved at an even pace.

name: Rammfish
description: A mutant predator of the wreck fields and one of the few fish listed for the narrow Pipecross / Deadly Tick bait pair.

name: Rivetback
description: A predator clinging to rusted infrastructure. Common across the demo's metal-strewn waters.

name: Sawfin
description: A mutant peaceful fish cruising the coral margins. Shares its bait affinity with the standard peaceful group.

name: Shardback
description: A Blight-twisted predator lurking among broken hulls. Rare, with few recorded habitats.

name: Shovelnose
description: A peaceful bottom-feeder of the soft-bottomed channels, with one of the widest habitat ranges among early fish.

name: Stormfin
description: A predator of exposed open water. Standard predator bait works; the challenge is reaching its grounds.

name: Tileback
description: A peaceful fish of the Trading Post flats, convenient for early bait testing near the shop.

name: Toadling
description: A small peaceful fish of the weedy shallows. Reliable early filler for the hold.

name: Snapper
description: The first contract fish. Five Snappers are the opening delivery for Gill and Bozur, and Earthworm is the only bait the species is listed for. A class 3 Snapper has 100 stamina.

name: Bonescar
description: An outer-channel predator listed for the Pipecross / Deadly Tick bait pair rather than the usual Rainbow Fin.

name: Bully
description: A level 10 predator of the Trading Post channels. Shares the narrow Pipecross / Deadly Tick affinity with Bonescar, Rammfish and Stonegnawer.

name: Crackback
description: A mutant predator of the blighted channels. Standard predator lures work despite the corruption.

name: Gleamer
description: A predator of the moonlit flats. Best targeted when night water is on the route anyway.

name: Harpooner
description: The predator contract fish. Three Harpooners unlock the Carburetor purchase at Betsy and Sons, making them the gate to the Upgraded Engine. Cast Rainbow Fin into a splash zone and retrieve steadily.

name: Harpy
description: A mutant predator active in night water. A natural bycatch of any night expedition.

name: Stonegnawer
description: A mutant predator gnawing through the concrete ruins, listed for the Pipecross / Deadly Tick bait pair.

name: Swallower
description: A mutant predator lurking inside sunken structures. Takes standard predator lures.

name: Softgrazer
description: The peaceful contract fish and the source of Chromatic Scales when processed at the Thresher. A class 3 Softgrazer has 110 stamina, unusually deep for a peaceful fish. Keep contract catches whole.

name: Bloodgill
description: A level 30 predator of the deep channels. Late-demo target with a strong per-kilogram value.

name: Greasechar
description: A level 30 predator of grease-stained water, found near old industrial wreckage.

name: Sharpfin
description: The most valuable peaceful fish in the demo data and the source of Sharpfin Flesh for the Deadly Tick bait. A class 3 Sharpfin has 120 stamina, the deepest pool recorded.
